title: Overview
text: Process Guide turns a video or live view into a guided workflow.

title: Choose a source
text: Choose a video file, camera, or shared screen. Here, we use the parts sorting example.

title: Add instructions
text: Upload a text guide, or choose a sample. Without a document, inferred steps remain provisional.

title: Set your wishes
text: Set your guidance preferences and personal wishes, then open the workspace.

title: Arrange the workspace
text: Your source stays on the left. Drag the divider to give either side more room.

title: Follow steps and principles
text: Steps and principles explain the action and its purpose. Evidence shows what the system observed.

title: Confirm carefully
text: Review each result. Manual confirmations remain clearly separate from AI observations.

title: Ask for guidance
text: Ask a typed question, or use voice controls. Speech and microphone access require your action.

title: Guardian observation
text: Guardian adds ongoing observation. Pause guidance whenever you need to inspect the source.

title: Check readiness
text: In Readiness, record the job context and complete your preparation checks before work.

title: Review and exceptions
text: Review lets you bookmark a frame and raise an exception when evidence needs attention.

title: Analysis report
text: Open the analysis report to review the workflow, observations, and unresolved issues.

title: Export and share
text: Prepare a PDF, export offline HTML, or share the file. Reports can include session details.

title: Save a result
text: Create or sign in to a private local account, then save the current result.

title: Return to saved results
text: Saved results remain available for review on this deployment. The simulator connection is planned, and inactive.
